+# Specification: Correction des diagnostics Docker Sandbox
+
+## Problem Statement
+
+Dans `acp-sandbox/src/runtime.ts`, la fonction `assertSuccess` utilise actuellement `result.stderr.trim() || result.stdout.trim()` pour construire les messages d'erreur. Cette approche masque systématiquement le contenu de stdout dès que stderr contient des données, ce qui entraîne une perte d'informations de diagnostic importantes pour le débogage des exécutions Docker.
+
+## Solution
+
+Modifier `assertSuccess` pour inclure les deux flux (stderr et stdout) dans les messages d'erreur avec des labels explicites, en préservant toutes les informations diagnostiques disponibles.
+
+## User Stories
+
+1. As a developer debugging Docker sandbox executions, I want to see both stderr and stdout in error messages, so that I can diagnose issues without missing critical information
+2. As a maintainer of acp-sandbox, I want consistent error formatting across all failure cases, so that error messages are predictable and machine-parseable
+3. As a CI pipeline operator, I want complete diagnostic output from failed Docker operations, so that I can identify root causes without rerunning commands manually
+
+## Implementation Decisions
+
+- **Error message format**: `[stderr] <trimmed content>` followed by `[stdout] <trimmed content>` on separate lines, both streams included only if non-empty
+- **Fallback behavior**: When both streams are empty, prefix with "Unable to <action>:" and include exit code N
+- **No truncation or deduplication**: Preserve full content without additional processing to maintain diagnostic fidelity
+- **Backward compatibility**: Public interfaces and diagnostics schema remain unchanged
+- **Test coverage**: Five test cases via DockerSandboxRuntime/fakeExecutor:
+  - stderr only (non-empty stderr, empty stdout)
+  - stdout only (empty stderr, non-empty stdout)
+  - both streams (non-empty stderr and stdout)
+  - neither stream (both empty, fallback to exit code message)
+  - success case (unchanged behavior, no error thrown)
+
+## Testing Decisions
+
+- Use existing DockerSandboxRuntime/fakeExecutor seam for testing
+- Test both error and success paths
+- Verify error message format matches specification exactly
+- Ensure existing tests continue to pass (npm test validation)
+- Focus on the assertSuccess function specifically
+
+## Out of Scope
+
+- Modification of public interfaces
+- Changes to diagnostics schema
+- Glossary or ADR updates
+- Any changes outside of acp-sandbox/src/runtime.ts and acp-sandbox/test/runtime.test.ts
+
+## Further Notes
+
+The fix addresses a critical diagnostic information loss bug where stdout was being systematically suppressed when stderr was present. The solution preserves all available diagnostic information while maintaining a clear, labeled format for human and machine consumption.
